business_summary: Ruijie Networks Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research, and sale of network equipment, network security products, and cloud desktop solutions in China and internationally. The company offers switches, such as campus network, and data center and cloud computing, as well as SDN, industry selected exchange series, and accessories; core, aggregation, access, and mobile routers; and access point products, including launch-type wireless, wall-mounted wireless, smart wireless, outdoor wireless, scenario-based wireless, wireless controller, industry-selected wireless series, and wireless management and applications. It also provides cloud desktop products comprising cloud terminal series, cloud server series, cloud desktop software series, and accessories series; and big data security platform, firewall, security gateway, testing and management security, and secure cloud products. In addition, the company offers network management products, and IT operations and maintenance products; identity management products consisting of safety management series, operations management series, and identity platform; infrastructure, basic maintenance, operation and maintenance management, whole service network, security, spare parts and expansion, and training and certification services. It serves telecommunications, internet, education, healthcare, manufacturing, and commerce industries. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
